notes: Period incidences with CIs come from the same national surveillance system (footnote ††) and are treated as the article's own; clinical prevalences for earlier periods are cited from published reports. view_issues: The text gives the 2023 median age as 7 years, while the table and footnote give 6.9 years (rounding). The 2023 incidence is stated to be an underestimate because reporting is incomplete.
